title: [Wear OS] Bad display of negative IOB
symptom: The negative symbol is not displayed on Wear OS complications when IOB is negative.
cause: The issue is related to regional/language settings: when using Norwegian or French format, the negative sign is displayed as a comma (e.g., "-0,00") and may not be shown correctly on the complication.
evidence_quote: So when I switched to English language on phone, and in AAPS, after a while I experience same issue on my test-rig. So it's related some how. I notice in norwegian format is "-0,00". but in english "-0.00".
